EditVersion 1
—
Set the tempo, move the play line under the preview to where it should kick in and press Start here. The camera cuts on the beat with a different move each time — it goes harder when the vocals are loud or harmonising and calmer when they're soft.
JVKE — autumn and butterflies. Warm sunset light, maple leaves drifting down, butterflies drifting through, and a calm camera that eases in on whoever's singing. Mark the big moment and every track grows out towards the camera.

Timing is worked out from your singing (mic) tracks, so it's approximate. Fix it on the strip under the preview: drag a word to move it, drag its edges to stretch it, Shift+drag (or drag the Line bar) to move a whole line, scroll to zoom. Words sung by two or more singers get the harmony gradient.
